description: The corner toast windows (label toast-<n>, created in screenshot/toast.rs): Capture cancelled, Copied to clipboard with Mark up after a capture, and Mark up in HL Desk after a device screenshot. They only call app commands (screenshot_toast_*, screenshot_read, screenshot_open, app_log); app commands are not ACL-checked while the app defines no app manifest (build.rs), so no permission is granted.
